citizenRequestsDataset.englishStandardizedText: The Primary Health Center has lacked a resident doctor or ultrasound for 2 years. Pregnant women must travel 65 km across the desert for delivery. Deploy telemedicine kiosk and medical staff.

citizenRequestsDataset.englishStandardizedText: Our school cluster has no internet or cellular connectivity. Students are cut off from digital education and government DPI services. Request high-speed optical fiber connection under BharatNet.
